about.label: about
about.title: About
about.body: Dodamdodam Korean Language School welcomes every student—from young children to adults—who wants to learn Korean language, culture, and history. Through Korean language education, culture and history learning, emotional coaching, and character education, we grow together in a healthy way.

tuition.label: tuition
tuition.title: Tuition
tuition.lead: Fees and payment information by class group.
tuition.elementaryLabel: Elementary / middle (Stem · Petal · Fruit · Elementary basics)
tuition.policyBody:
Tuition is based on the school calendar, including holidays and vacation periods.

The standard is to pay €300 for a 6-month semester before it starts. You may also pay monthly: €50 per month (€40 for one sibling when siblings enroll together).

Monthly payments are due by the first week of each month by bank transfer or cash.
tuition.trialBody:
One trial class is allowed and parents may attend together. Please contact the school in advance.

The trial fee is €20, payable in advance by cash or bank transfer.
tuition.admissionBody: The admission fee is €50, paid once upon enrollment by cash or bank transfer.
